StringColumn.Name: Port
StringColumn.Caption: Port
StringColumn.FullDescription: The port to which these settings apply.

StringColumn.Name: SenderID
StringColumn.Caption: Sender ID
StringColumn.FullDescription: The sender id to use when sending messages to this port. The value used here usually needs to be agreed upon between you and the port.

StringColumn.Name: Status
StringColumn.Caption: Status
StringColumn.FullDescription: The status of your relationship with this port. Disabled = you cannot send port authority messages to this port. Testing = messages will be sent to the ports test system (some ports like to go through a testing phase before accepting live messages). Live = messages will be sent to the ports live system.
